new_design.about.hero_title: The Katar Story: More than just a cup of coffee
new_design.about.hero_subtitle: We don't just sell coffee, we take you on a journey from the farm to the cup, where authenticity meets modernity in every sip.
new_design.about.vision_title: To be the premier destination for specialty coffee lovers in the region.
new_design.about.vision_desc: We seek to redefine the specialty coffee concept through continuous innovation and maintaining the highest international quality standards, creating a unique sensory experience for every customer.
new_design.about.mission_title: Spreading a culture of excellence and sustainability.
new_design.about.mission_desc: Our mission is to empower coffee farmers and deliver a product that respects both the environment and the consumer, with a focus on continuous education for our team and customers on the art of coffee roasting and brewing.
new_design.about.values_subtitle: The principles that guide us in every step we take towards excellence.
new_design.about.value_community_desc: Al-Katar is a hub for creators; we support local talents and create space for connection.
new_design.about.value_education_desc: We believe in sharing knowledge, from barista courses to coffee tasting workshops for our customers.
new_design.about.value_sustainability_de: We commit to fair trade practices that support farmers and protect the environment for future generations.
new_design.about.value_quality_desc: We never compromise on the quality of our crops, selecting only the top 5% of global coffee production.
new_design.about.why_subtitle: The secret of our excellence lies in the "journey of the bean". We don't just import coffee; we personally travel to farms in Ethiopia, Colombia, and Brazil to build direct relationships with farmers.
new_design.about.why_item1: Daily roasting in small batches to guarantee freshness.
new_design.about.why_item2: Innovative roasting techniques that highlight unique aromatic notes.
new_design.about.why_item3: Full traceability of the bean's origin and harvest date.
new_design.about.cta_title: Are you ready to start your journey with us?
new_design.home.why_desc: We believe coffee is not just a morning drink, but a narrative of the farmers, the terrain, and the precise roasting process. At Al-Katar, we follow strict standards to ensure an unforgettable sensory experience.
new_design.home.feat_roast_desc: We use the latest roasting techniques to highlight the natural notes latent in every coffee bean.
new_design.home.feat_trade_desc: We communicate directly with farmers in Ethiopia, Colombia, and Brazil to ensure the highest levels of sustainability.
new_design.home.feat_quality_desc: We select only crops scoring over 85 points according to Specialty Coffee Association standards.
new_design.home.cat_crops_desc: Discover our selection of whole coffee beans from the world's most famous farms.
new_design.home.cat_tools_desc: Everything you need to prepare the perfect cup of coffee at home with high professionalism.
new_design.home.cat_boxes_desc: Special collections designed to take you on a comprehensive and unique tasting journey.
new_design.home.cat_expert_desc: Starting your own business? Our consultants are here to help you every step of the way.
new_design.home.roast_desc1: Roasting is the true heart of the coffee world. In this stage, green coffee beans transform into beans rich in the flavors and aromas we love.
new_design.home.roast_desc2: Each roasting level reveals a different side of the coffee's character, from light floral notes to deep and intense flavors.
new_design.home.newsletter_subtitle: Subscribe to receive our latest updates

new_design.social_responsibility.title: Social Responsibility - Al-Katar Coffee
new_design.social_responsibility.hero_ti: Al-Katar Impact: From Farm to Community
new_design.social_responsibility.hero_su: We are committed to empowering our communities and protecting our natural resources for a sustainable future. We believe that every drop and every seed is the beginning of a shared success story.
new_design.social_responsibility.initiat: Stories from the Heart of the Community Told with Pride
new_design.social_responsibility.card1_d: Our integrated program to provide farmers with the latest sustainable agricultural technologies to raise local production efficiency.
new_design.social_responsibility.card2_d: Our investment in water conservation technologies saving up to 45% through smart and advanced irrigation systems.
new_design.social_responsibility.card3_d: Providing employment opportunities and vocational training for over 500 families around our farms to boost self-sufficiency.
new_design.social_responsibility.feature: Sustainability Oasis: Vision 2030 for a Better Environment

We do not just follow standards; we set new ones. The "Sustainability Oasis" project aims to create an integrated ecosystem completely reliant on renewable resources, making our farms leaders in maintaining ecological balance.
